heading: Tuesday, September 22, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5
items.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 is the first model in the Claude 5.5 family. Anthropic says it performs at about the level of Fable 5.1 on most work and reports 66.4% on Terminal-Bench 4.0. Pricing drops to $4/$20 per million tokens, which Anthropic estimates is about 40% cheaper than Opus 5 for typical workloads.

items.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna
items.summary: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are the smaller tiers of the GPT-6 generation, priced at roughly half their GPT-5.6 counterparts ($2/$10 and $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens). OpenAI claims Sol makes about half as many mistakes as its predecessor on an internal factuality evaluation.
